mapper.sql: SELECT id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, query, perms, icon, menu_type, visible, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_menu
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.path, m.component, m.query, m.perms, m.icon, m.menu_type, m.visible, m.status FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, query, perms, icon, menu_type, visible, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{menuName}, #{parentId}, #{orderNum}, #{path}, #{component}, #{query}, #{perms}, #{icon}, #{menuType}, #{visible}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
